columns.name: Id
columns.description: Primary key. Automatically generated by the database. Never include this column in INSERT SQL.

columns.name: ImageSrc
columns.description: The image source of the user. This column represents the user's profile picture.

columns.name: Username
columns.description: The user's login name. Use this column when the request refers to the user's name or username.

columns.name: Password
columns.description: The user's password. This column is used for authentication purposes.

columns.name: CreateAt
columns.description: Creation timestamp. This column is required. Use CURRENT_TIMESTAMP in INSERT statements unless another timestamp is explicitly provided by the user.

columns.name: RecordStatus
columns.description: MANDATORY column. This column MUST ALWAYS be included in every INSERT SQL statement. Use value 0.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: This column MUST ALWAYS be included in every INSERT SQL statement. Use value 0.
